message.content: The largest planet that has been observed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius roughly 2–3 times that of Jupiter—about 2.5 R_Jup. Because it is still forming, its exact mass is uncertain, but estimates suggest it could be several times the mass of Jupiter as well.
